0|0919e1b69ab459e06df45d3ba6658d281962db80|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"hugetlbfs: on restore reserve error path retain subpool reservation
When a huge page is allocated
column2: PagePrivate() is set if the allocation

column1: consumed a reservation.  When freeing a huge page
If set
column2: it indicates the reservation should be restored.  PagePrivate

column1: being set at free huge page time mostly happens on error paths.
When huge page reservations are created
column2: a check is made to determine if

column1: the mapping is associated with an explicitly mounted filesystem.  If so
pages are also reserved within the filesystem.  The default action when
freeing a huge page is to decrement the usage count in any associated
explicitly mounted filesystem.  However
column2: if the reservation is to be

column1: restored the reservation/use count within the filesystem should not be
decrementd.  Otherwise
column2: a subsequent page allocation and free for the same

column1: mapping location will cause the file filesystem usage to go 'negative'.
Filesystem                         Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
nodev                              4.0G -4.0M  4.1G    - /opt/hugepool
To fix
column2: when freeing a huge page do not adjust filesystem usage if

column1: PagePrivate() is set to indicate the reservation should be restored.
I did not cc stable as the problem has been around since reserves were
added to hugetlbfs and nobody has noticed.
